candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show every checkout correlation failing with an upstream 500 from order:8000, and gateway metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout while health routes stay 200.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs and dependency metrics were not admitted, so the internal cause of the order 500 (db, payment, inventory) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are explained by order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders across all sampled traces; topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Gateway health routes remain 200, so the gateway itself is healthy. Root cause is bounded to the order service erroring, though its internal trigger is not yet established.
